Scenes of domestic violence in films
†*261. SHRIMATI CHANDRA
KALA PANDEY:
SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Film Censor Board is
empowered to censor the scenes promoting
domestic violence in the films;
(b) if so, whether the Board is
discharging its duties in an appropriate
manner; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
TKDL project
*262. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether an MoU has been signed
between Indian Systems of Medicine and
Homoeopathy and National Institute of
Science Communication on 6th June, 2001
for establishing Traditional Knowledge
Digital Library (TKDL);
(b) whether first phase targets Ayurveda;
(c) if so, the details thereof and number
of slokas put on the portal;
(d) whether project TKDL had to be
completed by October, 2002;
(e) if so, the present status of the project;
(f) whether the project is expected to
have a website of approximately 1,40,000
pages;
(g) whether the website is available; and
(h) if not, the reasons therefor?
Investment in PSUs
†*263. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment with regard to investment in
all the public sector industries in the month
of March during the years 2000-2001,
2001-2002 and 2002-2003;

amount invested in these industries;
(c) the profit earned by these industries

and
(d) the amount paid as interest during
each of the above mentioned years?
Price of cement
*264. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the role of Government in fixing the
price of cement;
(b) whether there is any scope for fixation
of cement rates by Government;
(c) whether Government are aware that
the consumers are facing problems due to
imbalance between demand and supply;
and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to
increase the production?
Earnings of DD
*265. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) the revenue earnings of Doordarshan
during the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the steps being taken to re-organise
the marketing system of Doordarshan; and
(c) the source of revenue of Doordarshan
apart from advertisements?
Infant and maternal morbidity and
mortality rate
*266. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of infant and
maternal morbidity and mortality rate;
(b) how this differs from State to State;
(c) the factors responsible for high rate
of infant and maternal morbidity and
mortality;
(d) whether any targets have been fixed
for reducing them;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) how these have been achieved; and
(g) the steps taken by Government to
tackle the problem?
Construction of Vallar Padam
Container Terminal
*267. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have finalized
the company which is to undertake the
construction of Vallar Padam Container
Terminal; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to development of Patna
†*268. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
provide financial assistance under the

City;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when

Coverage of Iraq crisis
*269. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Doordarshan has decided to
engage a private producer to provide its
viewers coverage of the unfolding Iraq
crisis;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the owner of this Production
House has any outstanding dues to DD;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Cultivation of tea in Uttaranchal
†1852. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total area in Uttaranchal in which
tea is cultivated;
(b) whether it is a fact that great
possibilities are existing in the State for
production of high quality tea;
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to provide special assistance to the State
Government for renovation and
improvement of tea gardens; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Meeting of State Governments on
matters of commerce and industry
1853. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had recently convened a meeting with the
State Governments on the matters
concerning commerce and industry;
(b) if so, the details of the demands put
forth by various State Governments;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government of Karnataka has indicated that
it has prepared detailed report as per Central
Government's guidelines on development
of three clusters pertaining to Garment
Industry at Bellary, foundry products at
Belgaum and Cashew at Mangalore, which
have great export potential; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
Trade relations between
India and USA
†1854. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the areas in which trade relations have
been established between India and USA;
(b) whether Government have any
proposal to expand trade relations with USA;
(c) if so, whether new areas have been
identified for this purpose; and
(d) the steps being taken in this direction?

410
WIN2\SESSION\7978RS1 410
Trade and economic cooperation
between India, Russia, China
and Germany
1855. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether trade and economic
cooperation between India, Russia, China
and Germany have been on increase since
the year 2002 onwards;
(b) if so, whether large number of joint
projects with Russia, China and Germany
have been undertaken currently;
(c) whether the trade growth with
Germany, China and Russia are
continuously improving and details of
agreement signed with these countries;
(d) if so, to what extent trade with these
countries have been improving for the last
three years; and
(e) to what extent the steps are being
taken to improve the trade and economic
relations with these countries further?
Revamping the tea auction system
1856. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the growing variation in the prices of tea in
the domestic market as well as in the field of
export;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is a need to revamp the
tea auction system to bolster tea prices; and
(d) the other steps being taken to resolve
the problems in the tea industry?
BIS certificate for quality standard
of imports
1857. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
certain products are allowed only when BIS
certifies about their quality standards;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the quality tested by BIS of such
products during the last two years, year-
wise and products-wise; and
(d) the total import which was made after
BIS clearance during the said period, year-
wise and product-wise?
Export of gems and jewellery
1858. SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India's export of gems and
jewellery have recorded a rise in the previous
years;
(b) the worth of export during the last
three years, year-wise; and
(c) the steps being taken to further
increase the export?
Fall in production of tea
1859. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the production
of tea in the country has declined by 38
million kg. in 2002 recording a fall of about
815 million kg. as against 853 million in
2001 and the crop in South India during
2002 was estimated at 192 million kg. and a
similar fall was expected in North India also;

(b) if so, the reasons for fall in the
production; and
(c) the steps being taken to boost
production?
Export to China
